topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 43 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 6 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (nonblockinglzapp, lzapp, clonable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
